checks.name: frame x head overlap over the head swing
checks.criterion: overlap 0 at every psi in [-psi_b, psi_b] (step <= 0.25); contact only at |psi| = psi_b (pads)

checks.name: stop pads: both legs touch at +-psi_b, pads are the first and only stop beyond it
checks.criterion: at +-psi_b two pads (one per leg) within 0.01; at psi_b + 0.25 overlap with pads > 0 and nowhere else

checks.name: frame x wheel overlap, phi 0..45 step 0.5 and 0..358 step 2
checks.criterion: overlap 0 at every phi

checks.name: head x wheel overlap at every C-space-free (phi, psi)
checks.criterion: overlap 0 wherever the 2-D pallet clearance c(phi, psi) >= 0

checks.name: 3-D shadow test: only the pallet tips are the nearest head<->wheel contact
checks.criterion: gap_3d >= min(c_pins, 1.10) - 0.02 at every free pose

checks.name: (info) can the head reach the banking stops while the wheel is engaged?
checks.criterion: informational (no pass criterion): with centred journals the pallets meet a tooth before the stop pads, so a resting head leans on a tooth, not on a pad (SPEC 1 / 2.4(b) assume hard banking); journal play can make the pads reachable

checks.name: head journal radial gap (post vs bore)
checks.criterion: 0.35 +- 0.02 (min and max over the faceted polygons)

checks.name: head V-ridge <-> V-groove normal gap
checks.criterion: >= 0.33 (designed 0.35)

checks.name: head post top <-> bore roof (Z)
wheel journal radial gap (post vs bore)
checks.criterion: 0.35 +- 0.02 (min and max over the faceted polygons)

checks.name: wheel V-ridge <-> V-groove normal gap
checks.criterion: >= 0.33 (designed 0.35)

checks.name: wheel post top <-> bore roof (Z)
head band <-> frame fill / cavity walls (XY, posts and stop pads excluded)
checks.criterion: >= 0.5 for |psi| <= 12.2 (SPEC V6); variant swept gap 0.55 (>= 0.50)

checks.name: head legs <-> stop pads (approach towards the banking limit)
checks.criterion: SPEC V6 'head<->fill >= 0.50 for |psi| <= 12.2' cannot hold at the pads: SPEC 2.5 builds them to touch the leg flank exactly at psi_b. Reported, not failed; contact only at |psi| = psi_b is checked in V5

checks.name: head body above the band <-> frame (XY slices over the head's whole height, swept)
checks.criterion: >= 0.5 (SPEC V6 head<->fill; sculpt: replaces face mid <-> roof, every 0.2 mm from the band top up, all psi)

checks.name: head (band and body, from z_band0 + 0.05 up) <-> frame, 3-D (band tops under the covers, floors over the frame's cut flats; posts and stop pads excluded), swept
checks.criterion: >= 0.3937 (nothing closer than the designed Z gaps gap_z 0.4137 / 0.4137; sculpt: replaces face front layer <-> paws / decor)

checks.name: wheel <-> frame, XY / normal interfaces (journal excluded): teeth, cone, umbrella rim, skid rings and cap under / inside the static yarn ring
checks.criterion: >= 0.45 each XY (designed: teeth 0.50, cone 0.50 normal, rim 0.50, cap <-> ring 0.5 radial; XY slices z 10.45..21.45 every 0.1); 3-D above the rim top >= 0.4 (the designed Z gaps umbrella top / skid rings -> ring, 0.4137)

checks.name: spinning cap <-> static yarn ring (radial, constant), phi 0..358 step 2
checks.criterion: >= 0.48 (designed cap_gap 0.5 - 0.02, not below the wheel <-> frame XY minimum 0.45; sculpt: replaces knob <-> paw lip, SPEC 0.9)

checks.name: head above the band <-> wheel (umbrella / skid rings / cap) over the swing
checks.criterion: >= 1.4 at every psi (sculpt: the upper bound 2.0 is n/a - the chin faces the static yarn ring, not the wheel)

checks.name: skid-rib float Z gaps (back ribs under head / wheel; sculpt: cut flats under the head body, skid rings under the static ring, band tops under the covers)
checks.criterion: per interface back_ribs_to_head 0.4000, back_ribs_to_wheel 0.4000, frame_cut_flats_to_head 0.4137, skid_rings_to_static_ring 0.4137, band_top_to_chest_cover 0.4137, lowered_legs_to_cover 0.4137 (+- 0.02, min/max over the rib tops, all census poses)

checks.name: float field Z gaps (back plate / umbrella top under the static ring under the floats)
checks.criterion: per interface >= back_plate_to_head 0.95, back_plate_to_wheel 0.95, umbrella_top_to_static_ring 0.95

checks.name: smallest flat-over-flat Z gap between different bodies anywhere (census poses)
checks.criterion: >= 0.38 (nothing tighter than the designed rib floats)

checks.name: other designed Z gaps from the ray census at phi 0 / psi 0 (sculpt: covers, static ring)
checks.criterion: legs<->chest cover 0.4137, pallet<->plate 1.10 and skid rings<->static ring 0.4137 (+-0.02); frame<->cone vertical >= 0.4 (present)

checks.name: exported STL = three watertight, consistently wound, single-component shells
checks.criterion: 3 shells, each watertight + valid manifold

checks.name: exported STL equals the model at the print pose (symmetric difference)
checks.criterion: < 0.05 mm^3 per body (STL is current)

checks.name: print pose: pairwise disjoint, global minimum gap
checks.criterion: overlap 0; gap >= 0.35 (tol 0.002 for the exactly-0.35 journals)

checks.name: print pose: pallet / head band <-> tooth gap (3-D band layer)
3MF = one object, three named parts equal to the print-pose bodies, per-part infill set
checks.criterion: 1 object / 3 valid parts, sym. difference < 0.05 mm^3 each, frame 20 % gyroid, wheel + head 100 %

checks.name: print pose: floating bodies start above the rib tops (no moving gap in the first layers)
checks.criterion: min z >= 2.98

checks.name: captivity, with ridges: 1.0 mm +-X/Y/Z and +-3 deg tilts (journal + COM pivots) at 20 poses
checks.criterion: every displaced / tilted body interferes with the frame (marginal = still free by <= 0.02 mm after the 1.0 mm move: a stop designed at exactly 1.0, reported as warn)

checks.name: captivity, ridges deleted: 1.0 mm +-X/Y/Z and +-3 deg tilts (journal + COM pivots) at 20 poses
checks.criterion: every displaced / tilted body interferes with the frame (marginal = still free by <= 0.02 mm after the 1.0 mm move: a stop designed at exactly 1.0, reported as warn)

checks.name: free play before contact with the frame (bisection)
checks.criterion: XY play = journal; +Z play with ridges = ridge axial play (< 1.0); tilt play < 3 deg

checks.name: ridge-less lift stop: head by the frame covers over its band, wheel by the static yarn ring
checks.criterion: lift <= 1.0 (+0.02) and the contact is at the intended stop; warn when the play sits at the 1.0 limit itself

checks.name: ridge-less escape search: lift beyond the stop x lateral offsets x tilts
checks.criterion: no configuration with lift > stop is free of the frame

checks.name: head x wheel with the two bodies at opposite ends of their axial play
checks.criterion: adversarial (not a SPEC criterion): overlap here means the pallet tops can rub the umbrella plate when the knob is pressed in while the head sits high
